verdict.rationale: Bolna lets developers bring their own STT provider via Settings → Integrations, with Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs and others supported. Agents can be configured with multiple languages, auto-detect and switch mid-call across 40+ languages, and produce call transcripts retrievable via API. The evidence does not show STT model selection, keyword or key-term boosting, or any measured accuracy, so the story's control and accuracy elements are only partly covered. Missing for 10: key-term/keyword boosting configuration, STT model-level selection docs, independent evidence of transcription accuracy or real-time latency.
